engine: User Diva rev16519 VST2 + own compiled V8 Windows x64 VST2 effect, both executed under Wine. No subjective listening.
chain: Diva_Lead_v8.h2p: FX1 Off, small native Plate2 in FX2, Diva ARP Off

effect_checks.engine: Actual compiled Windows x64 VST2 under Wine; FL Studio not executed

synth_checks.note: Optimizer parameters are rounded by Diva when saved. The selected finishing was measured against the final saved preset in two fresh loads; gain was calibrated to that canonical render.

source_pattern.octave_limit: Absolute piano-roll note labels are not readable in the video; this register was chosen from the audio for our patch.

selection_objective: Same fixed spectrum/dynamics measurements as previous versions, plus harmonic phase/balance, band correlation error, aggregate correlation error and excess tail penalty. These rank candidates and do not measure a perceptual percentage.
phase_metric: 16 fixed note windows 55-145 ms, first 12 harmonics, summed L/R complex cross power within +/-max(7 Hz, harmonic*.45 Hz), FFT8192. Wrapped phase and balance errors weighted by reference harmonic power^0.65 across all windows.

arp_discovery.role: Verified native Diva generation from the three held root notes. This is not evidence of original settings. The fitted native arpeggiator candidate was less accurate in dynamics and steady timbre than the selected eight-event performance.

limitations: Original preset and effect chain unknown. V8 improves band/aggregate stereo width, harmonic balance, spectrum and some dynamics measurements. V7 retains a small harmonic phase advantage. Short compressed edited reference. FL Studio and subjective listening not performed. Exact or 99% match not established.

research_findings.native_plate2: 25 native-Diva probe renders followed by 40 finishing/timing combinations. Selected Wet 1%, Decay 30, Size 50.75. This improvement does not identify the original effect chain.
research_findings.transient_shaper: Tested linked fast/slow envelope shaping. Its lower attack-envelope error was offset by longer tail and other errors; final shaper amounts are zero.
research_findings.final_velocity_check: A later least-squares velocity correction reduced body error slightly but increased whole-fragment score and envelope errors; selected MIDI retained the earlier eight velocities.
research_findings.native_arp: Native Diva up+dn 2, two octaves, 1x, clock 1/8 generated the observed eight pitches from three held notes. The tested native-ARP fit was worse in dynamics and steady timbre than the selected expanded performance.
research_findings.reset: Native analogue/DC/VCF/oscillator reset variants were tested; the selected preset retains its analogue transient mode.
